name: kb_prepare_impact_review
description: Prepare an impact review of the current staged snapshot or explicitly selected immutable Git commits. Use it when kb_check reports that changed files need an impact review; it does not plan KB changes. Returns the record headers, a row per changed file with its requirement ids and pending obligations, each scoped requirement once with its fingerprints, and full evidence only for the paths you name; rows page with offset. It does not decide, approve, sign, stage, or prove the review; write the record with kb_author_impact_review.

scope.description: What to review: {"kind":"staged"} for the staged snapshot, or {"kind":"diff","baseCommit":"<sha>","headCommit":"<sha>"} with full commit hashes.
scope.x-kibi-advertised-description: {"kind":"staged"} for the staged snapshot, or {"kind":"diff","baseCommit","headCommit"} with full hashes.

paths.description: Changed paths to return full evidence and requirement context for; the rows still list the whole scope.

offset.description: First file row to return, from truncation.nextOffset.
